entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage planeswalker who devises the last-ditch plan to pull the titans into the physical world and drain them through the leylines.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker and commander whose charisma rallies the troops for the plan.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker who can weave the glyph from Zendikar's leylines and who shows Jace her memories.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker told not to attack the titans but to burn Eldrazi.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A merfolk planeswalker with the bident who rejoins the group humbled and agrees to clear the basin.

entities.name: Tazri
entities.description: A general rounding up survivors who agrees to rally the troops and says bait does not get a choice.

entities.name: Munda
entities.description: A kor ambusher among the gathered survivors.

entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: A merfolk ruin diver whose mind Jace reads and who leaves with Kiora.

entities.name: Drana's emissary
entities.description: A sulking vampire who represents Drana's interests and calls Tazri's strike plan suicide.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: An ancient dragon planeswalker who told Jace not to kill the titans or let them escape.

entities.name: Anowon
entities.description: A vampire sage who swore the Eldrazi would leave Zendikar if freed and who guided Jace to the Eye.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A tall, white-haired planeswalker whom Nissa distrusted.

entities.name: Drana
entities.description: A vampire leader whose interests are represented by an emissary.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan roaming Zendikar.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan whose iridescent trail covers the ravine.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The titans and their spawn.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The team of four planeswalkers who swore the oath to keep watch.

entities.name: Zendikari army
entities.description: The scattered soldiers and survivors that Tazri is rounding up, to be used as bait for the titans.

entities.name: Hedron network
entities.description: The network of hedrons that imprisoned the titans and dampened their energy.

entities.name: Glyph
entities.description: A circle with three equidistant projections, the shape the leylines must take to bind the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Leylines
entities.description: The lines of mana of Zendikar that Nissa can weave into the glyph without hedrons.

entities.name: Roil
entities.description: The wild weather of Zendikar that Nissa now sees as the plane fighting for its life.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: The center of the hedron network where Ugin spoke to Jace.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes where the rest of the titans' bodies lie.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane the four have sworn to protect.

entities.name: Bident of Thassa
entities.description: Kiora's weapon, which she twirls and uses to clear the basin.

events.summary: The four planeswalkers enter a ravine covered in Kozilek's trail and find Tazri, Munda, Jori En, Kiora and Drana's emissary arguing over a strike plan.
events.quote: Standing tall, bident in hand, cocky smile still in place, was the merfolk Planeswalker Kiora

events.summary: Gideon is reunited with the group, and Kiora offers a humble request for the next move.
events.quote: Which is why I'm here, now, asking you what we are going to do.

events.summary: Jace presents half a plan with the glyph that Ugin showed him, since a hedron trap for two titans is impossible.
events.quote: It's no longer possible to trap Kozilek and Ulamog,

events.summary: Jace announces that since they cannot trap the titans nor let them leave, they will kill them, revealing Ugin's warning he had promised to heed.
Jace proposes using the army as bait to bring the titans together, and Tazri says bait does not get a choice.
events.quote: The titans are drawn to concentrations of life,

events.summary: Jace explains Ugin's metaphor and concludes the titans can be pulled fully into the physical world to be killed.
events.quote: we pull the two titans into the physical world completely, and then we can kill them.

events.summary: Nissa shares her mind and memories with Jace, showing how the hedron network contained the titans and how the Roil was the world fighting back.
events.quote: She'd thought her world was angry. She hadn't realized it was fighting for its life.

events.summary: Nissa and Jace conceive a plan to drain the titans' energy into Zendikar's leylines without hedrons, so the plane can devour them.
events.quote: So this world can do to them what they 've been trying to do to it.

events.summary: Nissa admits she removed the last failsafe and let the Eldrazi out, and Jace confesses he was part of the reason the failsafe was needed.
events.quote: I let them out, said Nissa.

events.summary: Jace lays out the plan: lure the titans into an ambush, bind them with Nissa's leylines, and drain them, with Kiora clearing the basin and Chandra told not to attack the titans.
events.quote: When the time comes, Nissa weaves the leylines together and binds the titans.

events.summary: Jace warns that the titans may get bigger as they are drawn into physical space, and Kiora agrees to follow the plan with a warning.
events.quote: Meaning they may get, um, bigger,

events.summary: Gideon tells Jace he trusts him despite the demon's warning about telepaths.
Jace rallies the rear guard troops with Nissa, telling them they are the most important people on the battlefield.
events.quote: She'll be binding the titans, and ultimately she'll be the one who kills them.

relations.note: Gideon is one of the four who swore the oath.
relations.quote: But four Planeswalkers took an oath

relations.note: Jace and Nissa share minds and work out the plan together.
relations.quote: But Nissa and I think it can work.
Commander-General!" said Tazri, snapping to attention.

relations.note: Ugin gave Jace two directives, which Jace promised to follow if possible.
relations.quote: Ugin, who was much older and much smarter than any of them, had given Jace two very clear directives

relations.note: Nissa did not trust Sorin and so removed the last failsafe.
relations.quote: Because I didn 't trust Sorin, and I wanted to help my world.

relations.note: Gideon is the one who can make the troops believe the plan.
relations.quote: But you're the one who can make them believe it.
